name: P2-B graph_color robustness completion
purpose: Close SPEC Overnight Batch v0 P2-B graph_color robustness. The C1 reason/couple grid completed across v14/v16/v18/v20, R in {2,4,8,16}, conditions isolation/autonomous, and policies conflict_cot/chrono/oracle/random, n=40 per bin. The deeper v20 A_cache vs C_incontext oracle-search cost probe completed using fixed source indices reused from the v20 reason/couple selected slice. The attempted v22 fixed-index cost probe hung without checkpoint rows after model load and was stopped fail-closed; v22 cost is not read.
